card.name: Number right after the article a
card.fires_on: A number, or the space before one, that comes straight after "a" or "A", where it starts a compound measure or age such as "a 24-hour", "a 60-minute" or "a 36-year-old".

modes.label: Digit after a
modes.description: The first digit of a number after "a" that is followed by a hyphenated unit such as hours, minutes or years.

modes.label: Space or spelled number after a
modes.description: A space or spelled-out number after "a" or "A" that precedes a number-unit phrase.
